name: ANSI/IEEE indicator lamp symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for indicator lamp, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The incandescent lamp form identifies a visual indication load in the named vendor library. Its colour, supply and indicated condition are separate annotations; illumination must be interpreted from the connected signal path.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Follow the signal that energises the lamp.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A lamp lit from a command circuit does not necessarily confirm the commanded equipment has moved.
